intended_object: This is the counit natural isomorphism, given by identity components, used to build the equivalence `integralDenseOpenEquivalenceOver` between two models of the category of integral schemes over S with dominant rational maps. I inferred this from the file, where it is passed as `counitIso` at line 271.
explanation: The definition is an auxiliary piece of data: the counit isomorphism needed to assemble a `CategoryTheory.Equivalence` between two of the library's own encodings of the same category. The underlying mathematical fact is that the two models are equivalent. That fact is captured by `integralDenseOpenEquivalenceOver`, not by this natural isomorphism, which is a proof-construction device and has no counterpart in the literature. For the record, each component is the identity isomorphism. Naturality reduces to the library lemma `nativeHom_denseHom`, which says that going to the dense-open model and back sends each morphism to itself, so the construction is coherent.
